Messages.Author: TONY RICARDI
Messages.Body:
-> 3) In the basic rules, a vampire is burned only if you steal more
-> blood than it has.

I assume you meant, "stealing blood only burns a vampire if you steal
more blood than it has." The above sorta implies that stealing blood is
the _only_ way to burn a vamp in basic rules (i.e. punching him won't).

-> 5) If a vampire blocks an Archon, he or she burns 1 blood regardless
-> of which action the Archon was taking. (The use of the semi-colon in
-> the V:TES text implies that the point of blood is burned only when
-> the Archon is using his or her rush ability.)

Archon costs the Methuselah pool, not blood from the vamp.

Messages.Author: Chad Lubrecht
Messages.Body:
TONY RICARDI wrote:
>
> -> 3) In the basic rules, a vampire is burned only if you steal more
> -> blood than it has.

Hold on, does this hold true in the advanced rules too? In Jyhad,
stealing blood couldn't send a vampire to torpor so I assume it couldn't
burn one either. Has this been changed for V:TES, or is this just a
simplification in the basic rules? (I thought the basic rules had steal
blood treated as a normal strike)

Has there ever been released a list of changes between Jyhad and V:TES?
I really have no desire to read the V:TES rulebook to find all the little
changes.

Messages.Body:

Peace Chad,

No, it does not. In the full rules, stealing blood cannot torporize or burn
a vampire. Yes, it is a silly simplification of the crippled rules.
